name: Open Space Institute New England Land Conservation Due Diligence Fund
summary: Grants for small and mid-sized New England land trusts to cover early-stage costs of fee-acquisition conservation projects, up to the contract stage. Awarded quarterly through fall 2027 while funds last.

eligibility.rule: The project is not a conservation easement transaction
Request excludes prior, post-contract, easement, staff, survey, closing or stewardship costs
If submitting multiple applications, each is for a distinct project

documents: ZIP folder containing at least .shp, .shx, .dbf and .prj shapefile components

calls.label: Later quarterly cycles

status.quote: Proposals are accepted on a rolling basis. Please see the Fund's Request for Proposals for quarterly deadlines through Fall 2027.

calls.note: Proposals are accepted on a rolling basis; the Request for Proposals has quarterly deadlines through Fall 2027.

geography.quote: New England Land Conservation Due Diligence Fund supports small and mid-sized land trusts in early-stage project development expenses

access.quote: All proposals must be submitted on Foundant, OSI’s grant management platform.

window.quote: Proposals are accepted on a rolling basis. Please see the Fund’s Request for Proposals for quarterly deadlines through Fall 2027.

amount.quote: Grants up to $25,000 will be awarded quarterly through the fall of 2027, while funds are available.

applicant_types.quote: supports small and mid-sized land trusts in early-stage project development expenses

effort.quote: Applicants will apply for funding through Foundant, OSI's grant management platform.

eligibility.quote: This funding cannot support conservation easement transactions.

Reimbursements for diligence activities already paid for at the time of application • Diligence activities (including appraisals, title work, and legal services) to be incurred after the project is under contract • Costs associated with conservation easements • Staff time • Surveys • Recording fees or other closing costs • Stewardship expenses
Applicants may submit multiple applications, provided they are for distinct projects.

after_award.quote: Grantees will be expected to provide brief, informal status updates to OSI as the project develops over the 24-month period following the grant award.

documents.quote: The .zip folder must contain at least the .shp, .shx, .dbf., and .prj file components of the shapefile.
